origin.description: Shrinks each variance toward the median variance.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A data matrix, one observation per row.

arguments.name: lambda.var
arguments.text: Variance shrinkage intensity from 0 to 1. Omitted means estimate it. In Python the name is lambda_var.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. Omitted means equal weights that sum to 1.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.text: Print the intensity. The default is true.

origin.details: The intensity comes from the Opgen-Rhein and Strimmer formula. lambda.var equal to 0 recovers the empirical variances.
